sub_sector.value: Construction materials and sealants; specialty coatings

manufacturing_type.detail: Formulates specialty coatings, construction sealants, resin and epoxy flooring products, and concrete admixtures.

production_model.detail: Branded Rust-Oleum coatings and DAP sealants are produced for retail stock.

product_complexity.detail: Products include waterproofing and firestopping systems, high-performance resin flooring, and specialty concrete admixtures.

production_role.detail: Makes finished coatings, sealants and roofing products, supplies concrete admixtures, and provides related services.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves commercial and infrastructure projects, industrial construction and maintenance, and consumers working on their homes.

notes: The production model is inferred from stocked retail brands, and the group-wide production mix is unclear.
